packs.title: Dyson Logos maps
packs.author: Dyson Logos
packs.licenseAsStated: On each work's own post (sourceUrl), after his commercial-license paragraph: "For those that want/need a Creative Commons license, it would look something like this: Cartography by Dyson Logos is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License", linked to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Seen with curl on all 29 live posts on 2026-10-18 and in each post's 2019 Wayback snapshot (work.wayback). Stated by the artist himself on his own blog. His Commercial Maps page in the 2019-04-30 snapshot: "If you require a further license, they are ALSO released under the Creative Commons license: Cartography by Dyson Logos is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License . Note that you DO NOT need to include this license with your works that use these maps, as they are released under a full free license in addition". The same page today ("Updated June18th, 2026 - 707 Maps") gives "a free, royalty-free, commercial license" with credit to Dyson Logos and adds "I do, however, maintain moral rights over my works under the Canadian Copyright Act S28.1 and S28.2". Its CC sentence was still there on 2019-11-08 and gone by 2020-01-24 (Wayback).
packs.aiCheck: No AI tag or claim anywhere. Hand-drawn ink maps by Dyson Logos posted 2015-2019, before image generators; several posts show photos of the paper drawing in progress. Looked at all 29 on the contact sheet and at 1:1 crops of most: consistent hand, wobbly hand-ruled grids, hatched walls, legible hand lettering. The only grid irregularity is ordinary hand-drawn drift (Toronin Ruins, Herlihy Farm).

packs.author: The Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup developers and artists
packs.licenseAsStated: crawl/tiles README.md: "Many of those artist making these changes have signed off their copyright, returning these tiles to a license similar to \"public domain\", CC Zero (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). ... While every care possible has been taken to separate those tiles released into CC Zero from those who have not or can not be contacted, if you happen to see a tile incorrectly included in this export, please contact the maintainer." ARTISTS.md: "The following is the list of artists that gave approval in 2010 for their artwork to be released under CC:0. It is asserted that this covers any new art submitted to Crawl." followed by a second list: "The following artists have given explicit approval that past and future artwork submitted to crawl is under CC:0." DCSS's own LICENSE (github.com/crawl/crawl): "The majority of Crawl's tiles and artwork are released under the CC0 license ..., and new submissions are under this license unless otherwise specified. However, the licensing situation may be complex, especially for older pieces. For information regarding the licenses of our tiles and artwork, see https://github.com/crawl/tiles"
packs.aiCheck: Hand-made pixel art from 2006 to 2015, before generative image tools. One consistent roguelike style. Nothing to flag.
packs.attributionNote: Not required. The tiles' readme asks, as a courtesy, that the developers and artists are credited and the source named.

Our assets are all licensed as CC0". Stated by Poly Haven as the rights holder. Same source and wording as the 11 Poly Haven stamps already shipped.
packs.aiCheck: Poly Haven publishes scans and hand-made models by named artists, each listed with authors in its API. No AI tags on any pick. Looked at every thumbnail: real materials and consistent lighting, labels and stencils are real lettering (W.E.C. on the crate). The owner cleared Poly Haven models of any date.
